verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Databricks serves an llms.txt at docs.databricks.com that describes the platform documentation for agents. A runtime probe also shows the official CLI installs vendor agent skills, including a databricks-docs skill, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others, so agents can consume the docs directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt's scope and structure (e.g. full-text or per-page markdown variants).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.databricks.com/llms.txt # Databricks Documentation

keylessly wrote 29 plain SKILL.md skill folders (databricks-docs, databricks-dbsql, databricks-lakeflow-connect, databricks-vector-search, …) with agentskills-style frontmatter, installable for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and more
